listing.name: Colony Helper - QoL for Managing Colonies
listing.summary: Changes colony item tooltips to list player/friendly colonies than can use the item, with player colonies given priority.
listing.aiSummary: Enhances colony item tooltips by listing which player or friendly colonies can utilize specific items.

description:
Description

Changes colony item tooltips to list player/friendly colonies than can use the item, with player colonies given priority.

Preview

Spoiler

Download
https://github.com/MildlyFootwear/starsector-ColonyHelper/releases

Changelog

0.1.7

Colonies under player control will show up as player colonies rather than the faction that they belong to, notable for Question of Loyalty.

Spoiler
0.1.6

Removed seemingly nonfunctional optimization code to hopefully resolve the colony display eventually stopping updating bug.

0.1.5

Tooltips will now say "Player faction" instead of the full name of the faction the player belongs to for clarity's sake.
Fixed erroneous description in the mod's settings menu.
Fixed some false positives, notably between mining and tech mining industries.

0.1.4

Added luna settings to allow configuration of how many factions/colonies are shown in a tooltip.
Patched tooltips not updating correctly mid session.

0.1.3

Patched player colonies getting skipped from new conditions being incorrectly parsed.

0.1.2

Patch for crash when player has no colonies or friendly factions.

0.1.1

When no player colonies have a slot for an item, friendly factions will be looked at, with high relations given priority.
Lists abbreviated system name next to colony name.

0.1.0

Colony item tooltips will now show a list of player colonies that can make use of said item.

aiDescription: Modifies item tooltips to display a list of colonies capable of using that item. Player-controlled colonies are prioritized in the list, followed by friendly factions based on relationship levels. Includes configuration options for the number of entries shown.
